items.translation: 使用 `COUNT_ALIAS` 作为别名时，COUNT 的值。

items.source: This ensures that the framework will be able to map the JSON result to this CountFragment class so that it can be used.
items.translation: 这确保了框架能够将 JSON 结果映射到该CountFragment类，以便使用。

items.source: The query should use the COUNT_ALIAS, eg.: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM default;
items.translation: 查询应使用 COUNT_ALIAS，例如：SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM default;

items.source: Use this alias for the COUNT part of a N1QL query so that the framework can extract the count result.
items.translation: 使用此别名作为 N1QL 查询的 COUNT 部分，以便框架能够提取计数结果。

items.source:
Use this alias for the COUNT part of a N1QL query so that the framework can extract the count result. Eg.: "SELECT
A.COUNT(*) AS " + COUNT_ALIAS + " FROM A";
items.translation: 使用此别名作为 N1QL 查询的 COUNT 部分，以便框架能够提取计数结果。例如："SELECT A.COUNT(*) AS " + COUNT_ALIAS + " FROM A"；

items.source: An utility entity that allows to extract total row count out of a COUNT(*) N1QL query.
items.translation: 一个实用实体，用于从 COUNT(*) N1QL 查询中提取总行数。
